description: Searches Google Maps for local places and businesses and returns up to 20 places (name, address, rating, reviews_count, place_id). Give a location such as "Rome, Italy" or name the place in the query; a search that finds nothing returns NO_DATA and is not charged. It does not return opening hours, phone numbers, review texts or coordinates, and is not web search (use google_search). Required: query.

language.description: Two-letter language code for names and addresses, e.g. "en" or "it". Omit for the source default, en.

location.description: Place to centre the search on, as city and country, 1-200 characters, e.g. "Rome, Italy". Without it, a place named in the query ("pizza in Rome") is used.

query.description: What to find, 1-500 characters, e.g. "pizza" or "pizza in Rome".

results.description: Maximum places returned, integer 1-20, default 10, e.g. 5.

name: google_maps_places
title: Google Maps Places
